# Repository Copilot workflow

For a SystemC-to-Spec conversion, complete and validate the candidate campaign first. The user-wide `SystemC Spec Reviewer` agent is maintained at `C:\Users\guojiamin\.copilot\agents\systemc-spec-reviewer.agent.md`; do not create repo-local or design-local copies of this agent. A rule marked `confirmed` means only that the bounded Evidence Gate passed, not that a human accepted the specification. Review the actual bounded behavior claims and evidence: a pending decision or workflow-status wording in the candidate spec is not, by itself, a reason to reject otherwise sound behavior content. Before presenting a recommendation, automatically invoke the `SystemC Spec Reviewer` agent with the exact campaign path when agent delegation is available, then report its findings and ask the user for the validation decision. If the current session cannot invoke another agent, do not claim that it did; perform and disclose a read-only review in-session. The user's complete SystemC-to-Spec conversion workflow ends at an immutable release: when the user explicitly accepts the review recommendation for that exact campaign/version, immediately record accept with schema-supported fields, verify reviewed SHA-256 bindings and the complete unknown list, run Harness `finalize --campaign <campaign>`, verify finalized artifacts, then continue to promotion and verify the immutable release. Do not ask the user to repeat authorization or leave them to edit files. If the user explicitly limits the request to acceptance/finalization or forbids release, stop at that scope. Harness may normalize supported workflow-status text when producing the finalized spec; do not preemptively reject a candidate on that basis. If schema/finalize/promotion fails, preserve artifacts and report the exact blocker without claiming completion.
